name: SmartWarmupAI
intro: SmartWarmupAI helps your emails reach the inbox. Connect mailboxes, warm them up, send campaigns, and handle replies in one place. Here is a quick tour of the dashboard.

features.connect-mailboxes-accounts: Accounts lists every mailbox you have connected, with its warmup status and health. Add a new mailbox here, whether it is Gmail, Microsoft 365 or any other email account.
features.warmup: Open a mailbox and go to its Warmup tab. Start warmup builds up sending volume gradually and replies to messages, so your mailbox earns a good reputation before real campaigns.
features.campaigns-and-sequences: Campaigns is where you build cold email sequences. Name a campaign, choose who should get it, write the steps and delays, and pick which mailboxes send.
features.inbox: The inbox gathers replies from all your mailboxes in one place. Use views like action required and hot leads to see which conversations need an answer first.
features.contacts: Contacts holds the people you email. Group them into segments, tag them with labels, and keep a suppression list so nobody who opted out is ever contacted again.
features.crm-pipelines-deals-tasks-meetings: The CRM tracks deals as they move through pipeline stages. Add tasks and meetings to each deal, so follow-ups from a reply never slip through the cracks.
features.analytics-and-reports: Analytics shows emails sent, open rate and reply rate over the period you choose. Reports let you share campaign results with clients, so everyone sees what is working.
features.deliverability-and-placement-tests: Deliverability shows how well your mail lands across mailboxes, including inbox rate, spam rate and bounce rate. Run placement tests to see where your emails really arrive.
features.ask-remie-ai-assistant: Ask Remie opens the built in AI assistant. It answers questions about your campaigns and can take actions for you, asking your permission before it changes anything.

outro: That's SmartWarmupAI. Warm your mailboxes first, launch a small campaign, and use the inbox and analytics to see what earns replies.
